What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number never updates, this can happen while the courier processes the package.
Wait a few days after shipment for the first scan to appear. Tracking may stay blank until the courier picks up and scans the parcel. 
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s official tracking page. Updates often appear once the package reaches a facility.
Allow for delays caused by high shipping volume, weather, holidays, or courier system backlogs.
If there are still no updates after 3–5 business days, contact the courier directly using the tracking number to ask about the shipment status.
If the courier cannot provide information after that, you can also reach out to our care team at care@nurosym.com with the tracking number so the situation can be reviewed.
